method: Finished prior P3 is the immutable B0 floor. One existing fine-grid search per eligible enabled encode, unchanged production selector and guards. Raw and selected outputs are separate. Strict capped retention is posthoc only. No gain/delay/source fitting or criterion tuning. Whole disabled/enabled encode wall and CPU times include capture/validation work inside encodeAccuracy but exclude separate output diagnostics; isolated optional phase time is unmeasured. Single-run host time differences are not controlled speed ratios. PWM diagnostics are inactive for PCM selection. Reserve sources and artifacts are bound only in the ignored private journal; unavailable STOI remains in case/byte/error denominators.
